blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Dhārā Bench is a retrieval benchmark for Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS), with 325 questions in 12 categories and 60,121 text chunks from 15 source groups. The categories were developed based on 4,500 questions submitted to the Dhārā application; the evaluation set combines corpus-aligned application queries with expert-contributed questions. The annotations comprise 7,578 question-chunk relevance links involving 6,847 distinct corpus chunks. For 34 composite and multi-hop questions, 401 conjugate groups specify alternative sets of passages that jointly support each question. Chunk identifiers and hierarchical references connect the judgments to their source texts. The paper describes corpus preparation, annotation, and validation, and reports a fixed BM25 baseline implemented with Pyserini with $k_1=0.9$ and $b=0.4$. Across all questions, BM25 achieves MRR@20 of 0.315, Recall@10 of 0.182, and nDCG@10 of 0.205. On the group-annotated subset, complete-evidence scores are CE_Recall@20 = 0.294 and CE_MRR@20 = 0.141. The category results expose particularly weak verse retrieval, while group scores reveal gaps between finding individual passages and completing their support. The corpus and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/Avinash2236/Dhara-Bench.
blocks.zh: Dhārā Beach是印度知识系统(IKS)的检索基准,有12个类别的325个问题和15个来源组的60 121个文本块。 这些类别是根据向Dhārā申请提交的4,500个问题制定的;该评价集将委托书申请查询与专家提出的问题结合起来。 说明包括7 578个问题与相关性联系,涉及6 847个不同的实体块。 对于34个综合和多跳题,401个组合组指定了共同支持每个题的替代段落. 春克标识符和分级引用将判断与源文本相连接. 该文件介绍了物料编制、注释和鉴定情况,并报告了与Pyserini一起实施的固定BM25基准,数额为1美元=0.9美元和0.4美元。 在所有问题中,BM25实现了0.315的MRR@20、0.182的回召@10和0.205的nDCG@10。 在组合附加说明子集上,完整证据分数为CE_Recall@20=0.294和CE_MRR@20=0.141. 分类结果暴露出格外薄弱的诗句回取,而组分则揭示出在寻找个别段落和完成支持之间有差距. 授权书和评价守则见https://github.com/Avinash2236/Dhara-Bench。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: India’s intangible heritage includes knowledge sustained through oral traditions, written texts, formal learning, and community practice. The term Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) covers these codified traditions and the practical expertise passed down within communities ( 5 ) . Its fields include philosophy, grammar, logic, mathematics, astronomy, architecture, medicine, agriculture, metallurgy, and trade, alongside literature and everyday practices such as dress, language, ethics, and cuisine ( 15 ) .
blocks.zh: 印度的非物质遗产包括通过口述传统、书面文本、正式学习和社区实践维持的知识。 印度知识系统(IKS)一词涵盖这些已编纂的传统和社区内部传出的实际专门知识(5个)。 其领域包括哲学,语法,逻辑学,数学,天文学,建筑学,医学,农业,冶金学,以及贸易等,此外还有文学和日常习俗,如服饰,语言,伦理等(15.

blocks.en: Indian philosophical inquiry gives attention to both the object of knowledge ( prameya ) and the means of valid knowledge ( pramāṇa ) ( 14 ) . Yoga accepts three means: perception ( pratyakṣa ), inference ( anumāna ), and authoritative testimony ( āgama ) ( 1 ) . Advaita Vedānta recognizes six: perception, inference, testimony ( śabda ), comparison ( upamāna ), postulation ( arthāpatti ), and non-cognition ( anupalabdhi ) ( 19 ) . These traditions combine observation, reasoning, and transmitted knowledge. Working with their texts therefore calls for examining the origin, relevance, and validity of supporting material before drawing conclusions.
blocks.zh: 印度哲学调查既关注知识对象(prameya)也关注有效知识手段(pramāṇa) (14. 瑜伽接受三种方式:感知(pratyakṣa),推论(anumāna),权威证词(āgama) (1). Advaita Vedāta承认六:感知、推论、证词( abda)、比较(上),假设(arthāpatti)和不认知(anupalabdhi)(19)。 这些传统将观察、推理和知识传播结合起来。 因此,在作出结论之前,必须先审查佐证材料的来源、相关性和有效性。

blocks.en: Finding that evidence is a substantial task. A reader may seek a verse from its opening words, the meaning of an Indic term, a sequence of events, or passages supporting an interpretation. Prose chapters, verses, sūtras, and commentaries also differ in length and reference conventions. Some questions can be addressed from one passage; others require material from several locations.
blocks.zh: 找到证据是一项重大任务。 读者可以从其开口语中取出一首诗句,意为"印地语"(Indical)一词的含义,一系列事件,或支持解释的段落. 起草各章、节、句和评注的篇幅和参考公约也各不相同。 一些问题可以从一个段落中解决;其他问题需要来自若干地点的材料。

blocks.en: Dhārā Bench provides a shared corpus and expert annotations for studying this retrieval problem. A system ranks existing text chunks in response to a question, and evaluation compares their identifiers with the annotated passages. Here, evidence means inspectable textual support. The validity of source claims and the correctness of answers synthesized from them require separate assessment.
blocks.zh: Dhārā法官为研究这一检索问题提供了一份共同的书目和专家说明。 一个系统针对一个问题对已存在的文本块进行排序,评价将其标识符与附加说明的段落进行比较。 这里,证据是指可检查的文本支持. 需要单独评估来源主张的有效性和从中归纳的答案的正确性。

blocks.en: The collection contains 325 questions in 12 categories and 60,121 chunks from 15 source groups. Questions were selected from corpus-aligned Dhārā application queries and supplemented by domain experts. The annotations record 7,578 question-chunk links covering 6,847 distinct chunks. For 19 composite and 15 multi-hop questions, 401 conjugate evidence groups identify alternative sets of passages that jointly support the whole question. These groups allow evaluation to distinguish finding a useful passage from assembling sufficient support.
blocks.zh: 该汇编包含12个类别的325个问题和15个来源组的60 121个块。 问题选自对Dhārā申请的物状调查,并由域专家补充。 说明记录了7 578个问答环节,涉及6 847个不同的块。 对于19个综合问题和15个多跳问题,401个相交证据小组确定了共同支持整个问题的替代段落. 这些小组使评价能够区分找到一个有用的段落和收集足够的支持。

blocks.en: The paper describes source preparation, question selection, annotation, and validation. A fixed BM25 baseline supplies overall and category-wise results, including scores for group completion. The accompanying GitHub release provides the corpus, questions, annotations, source metadata, rankings, and evaluation code.
blocks.zh: 论文描述了源头准备,问题选择,注释,以及验证. 固定的BM25基线供应总体和分类结果,包括分组完成的分数。 配套的"GitHub"发布提供了命题,问题,说明,源元数据,排名和评价代码.

blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.zh: 页:1 1. 相对于代表性检索、印度语、文化和IKS相关资源的定位。

blocks.en: BEIR’s original suite of 18 datasets covers domains such as biomedical literature, finance, news, and Wikipedia, but has no dedicated IKS collection ( 20 ) . KILT uses a shared Wikipedia snapshot to evaluate knowledge-intensive NLP tasks and their provenance ( 13 ) . Encyclopedic coverage can include IKS topics; Dhārā Bench instead organizes retrieval judgments around the selected source works and their internal textual locations.
blocks.zh: BEIR最初的18个数据集包涵盖了生物医学文献,金融,新闻,和维基百科等领域,但没有专门的IKS收藏(20). KILT使用共享的维基百科快照来评价知识密集型的NLP任务及其出处(13. 百科全书的涵盖范围可以包括IKS主题;而Dhārā Bench则围绕所选源作品及其内部文字位置组织检索判断.

blocks.en: Indic-QA covers extractive and abstractive question answering in 11 Indian languages ( 18 ) . SANSKRITI assesses Indian cultural knowledge ( 8 ) , and IndQA uses expert-authored questions and rubrics to assess culturally grounded knowledge and reasoning ( 11 ) . These resources overlap with IKS in language or subject matter and evaluate answers. Dhārā Bench supplies ranked-passage judgments over a fixed corpus.
blocks.zh: Indica-QA以11种印度语言(18个)回答采掘和抽象问题。 SANSKRITI评估印度文化知识(8),IndQA使用专家撰写的问题和题材评估以文化为基础的知识和推理(11). 这些资源在语言或主题事项上与IKS重叠并评价答案. Dhārā座椅用品对固定体的通过判决进行排序。

blocks.en: Anveshana pairs 3,400 English queries with Sanskrit documents from Śrīmadbhāgavatam for cross-lingual retrieval ( 3 ) . Mandikal ( 9 ) studies retrieval-augmented long-form question answering in Advaita Vedānta using the VedantaNY-10M datastore of public discourses. SanskritShala offers Sanskrit NLP tools for teaching and annotation ( 16 ) , while IKS-Instruct supplies multilingual instruction-response data for model adaptation ( 17 ) . The contribution here is a common retrieval evaluation across 15 source groups, 12 question categories, and expert-selected passages.
blocks.zh: Anveshana对3 400个英文查询,其中附有来自Śrīmadbhāgavatam的梵文文件,供交叉语言检索(3个)。 Mandikal(9人)利用VedantanY-10M公共话语数据库,在Advaita Vedāta中研究取回的长式回答问题。 梵语 夏拉提议 用于教学和注释的梵文NLP工具(16个),而IKS-Instruct为模型适应提供多语种教学-响应数据(17个). 这里的贡献是,对15个来源小组、12个问题类别和专家选定的段落进行共同检索评价。

blocks.en: HotpotQA annotates sentence-level supporting facts across documents ( 25 ) ; MuSiQue connects questions through dependent reasoning steps ( 22 ) ; and Multi-Hop Dense Retrieval studies supporting-passage retrieval for complex questions ( 24 ) . Dhārā Bench records alternative chunk groups for composite and multi-hop questions. Section 6 defines this representation, and Section 8.1.6 specifies how group completion is scored.
blocks.zh: HotpotQA将句子层次的辅助事实跨文档(25)进行注释;MuSiQue通过依赖推理步骤(22)将问题连接起来;和多Hop Dense检索研究为复杂问题进行辅助-通过检索(24). Dhārā法官组记录了混合和多跳问题的其他组别。 第6节界定了这种代表,第8.1.6节具体规定了团体的完成方式。

blocks.zh: 3个 源代码

blocks.en: 3.1. Selection of works
blocks.zh: 3.1. 作品的选择

blocks.en: The 15 source groups cover epic narratives, Purāṇic literature, Vedic hymns, philosophical dialogues, sūtras, and story collections, together with treatises on medicine, performing arts, and architecture. Modern studies cover mathematics and South Indian history. Table 2 lists the works and their principal IKS domains.
blocks.zh: 15个来源小组涉及史诗叙事、Purāṇic文学、吠陀赞美诗、哲学对话、诗集和故事集,以及关于医学、表演艺术和建筑的论文。 现代研究涵盖了数学和南印度历史. 表2列出了作品及其主要IKS领域.

blocks.en: Selection sought variety in textual form and subject matter. Some groups contain several editions, translations, or commentaries on one work. The Bhagavadgītā forms a separate group because the corpus includes dedicated translation and commentary resources for it.
blocks.zh: 选择寻求文字形式和主题事项的多样性。 一些小组载有若干版本、翻译或对一作的评论。 Bhagavadgītā是一个单独的群体,因为教程包括专门翻译和评论资源。

blocks.zh: 页:1 2. Dhārā座堂的15个资料来源组及其主要的IKS领域。

blocks.en: The corpus provides English translations and explanations, while retaining Sanskrit terminology, source expressions, and quotations where present. Machine translations were produced where required using a locally hosted, instruction-tuned Gemma 4 31B model ( gemma-4-31B-it ) ( 2 ) . Domain-specific IKS technical terms are also retained in the questions.
blocks.zh: 教程提供了英文翻译和解释,同时保留了梵语术语,源词和所存在的引文. 必要时使用本地主机Gemma 4 31B型(gemma-4-31B-it)(2)生产机器翻译。 特定领域 问题中还保留了IKS技术术语.

blocks.en: 3.2. Acquisition and provenance
blocks.zh: 3.2. 购置和来源

blocks.en: Machine-readable web pages were acquired by text extraction; scanned PDFs were converted with Surya OCR ( 12 ) . The source manifest gives bibliographic descriptions and URLs for the resources within each group.
blocks.zh: 机器可读网页是通过取出文本获得的;扫描的PDF与Surya OCR(12)被转换. 来源清单提供了每一组内资源的书目说明和URL。

blocks.en: Each corpus record has 3 fields: id , its unique integer identifier; chunk , the searchable text; and ref , the hierarchical location in the source. Evaluation uses the identifier to connect a judgment to a specific passage; the reference and manifest allow that passage to be inspected in its textual and bibliographic context.
blocks.zh: 每个实体记录有3个字段: id,其独特的整数标识符; 块,可搜索文本; 和 ref, 来源的分级位置. 评价利用标识符将判断与某一具体段落联系起来;参考和显示允许在文字和书目上检查该段落。

blocks.zh: 3.3. 数据和代码可用性

The repository also contains BM25 scripts in scripts/ , and saved rankings and metric outputs in metric_outputs/ . blocks.en: 4. Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 4.四. 数据集建设

blocks.en: 4.1. Question collection and taxonomy development
blocks.zh: 4.1. 问题收集和分类学发展

blocks.en: Analysis of 4,500 questions submitted to the Dhārā application 1 1 1 Dhārā application: https://dhara.bheri.in/ . led to 12 question categories, T01-T12. Questions were grouped by their main requested operation: the same source could be queried for a fact, a list, a word meaning, a verse, or an interpretation. This produced an empirical scheme based on application use.
blocks.zh: 对提交Dhārā申请的4,500个问题的分析 1 1 Dhārā申请: https://dhara.bheri.in/. 引出12个问题类别 T01-T12. 问题按所请求的主要操作分类:同一来源可以问一个事实、一个清单、一个词的含义、一个诗句或一个解释。 这产生了一个基于应用的实证计划。

blocks.en: Most categories describe tasks found across domains, including fact lookup, enumeration, counting, chronology, composite queries, multi-hop reasoning, and false-premise correction. Lexical understanding (T05) and verse or textual retrieval (T08) are particularly relevant to scholarly discourse in IKS. T05 covers the meaning or equivalent of an Indic term, including its use within a verse. T08 covers locating, identifying, or completing a text from opening words, a numbered reference, or a paraphrased meaning. Such tasks also occur in other literary traditions; their distinctive demands here arise from Indic terminology, textual forms, and reference conventions.
blocks.zh: 大多数类别描述发现跨域的任务,包括事实查取,查点,计数,时间顺序,综合查询,多跳推理,以及假真校正等. 语法理解(T05)和诗或文字检索(T08)与IKS的学术论述特别相干. T05涵盖一个indic术语的含义或等同性,包括它在一诗中被使用. T08涵盖从开口词中查找、识别或完成一个文本、一个编号的参考物或一个被解释的含义。 此类任务也出现在其他文学传统中;它们在这方面的独特要求来自印地语术语、文字形式和参考公约。

blocks.en: Interpretive questions (T11) depend on concepts within a textual tradition, while computational questions (T12) draw on its rules, quantities, or procedures. T12 includes rule-based lexical derivation, distinguished from meaning lookup in T05. Table 3 gives the full definitions.
blocks.zh: 解释性问题(T11)取决于文字传统中的概念,而计算问题(T12)则借鉴其规则,数量,或程序. T12包括基于规则的词典衍生,区别于T05中的含义取向. 表3列出了全部定义。

blocks.en: The final 325 questions combine corpus-aligned application queries with questions supplied by domain experts. Each record retains its original wording, receives a unique query_id , and has one primary category. The category counts describe this selected set, rather than the distribution of all 4,500 application questions.
blocks.zh: 最后的325个问题结合了事由与事由一致的应用问题和域专家提出的问题。 每张唱片保留了原来的用词,收到一个独特的查询_id,并有一个主类. 类别计数描述的是所选的这套,而不是所有4500个应用问题的分布.

blocks.en: 4.2. Chunk construction
blocks.zh: 4.2. 春克建筑

blocks.en: Prose chapters were segmented independently with LangChain’s RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter ( 6 ) , using a target of 1,800 characters and an overlap setting of 250 characters, measured by Python’s len . Splits followed paragraph boundaries where possible, then line boundaries, periods followed by a space, and individual word separators. Chunks and overlaps stayed within chapter boundaries. Leading periods introduced by splitting and surrounding whitespace were removed.
blocks.zh: Prose分章节与LangChain的RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter (6) 独立分出,使用目标为 1,800个字符和250个字符的重叠设置,由 Python len 测量. 在可能的情况下,拆分沿着段落边界,然后是行边界,然后是时段,然后是空格,然后是单个单词分隔符。 断层和重叠仍停留在章节界限之内。 拆分和周边白地引入的前期被去除.

blocks.en: A verse and its explicitly linked translation or commentary were kept together when they fit within approximately 1,800 characters. Longer units were split with their textual location retained. These rules account for records that exceed the prose target.
blocks.zh: 诗篇及其明确联系的翻译或评论,如果符合约1 800个字符,则合在一起。 较长的单位被拆分,保留了文字位置。 这些规则对超过道教目标的记录做出了规定.

blocks.en: 4.3. Evidence annotation
blocks.zh: 4.3. 证据说明

blocks.en: Domain experts identified candidate passages using their knowledge of the source works. They were permitted to use the Dhārā application and tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude to supplement their expertise and search as comprehensively as possible for relevant evidence. Experts inspected candidate passages against corpus records, judged their relevance, and recorded the selected chunk identifiers. On average, 2 experts annotated each question. Their selected chunk identifiers were combined by taking the union of their annotations and removing duplicates.
blocks.zh: 域专家利用自己对源作品的了解,确定了候选段落. 他们获准使用Dhārā应用程序和工具,如双子座、ChatGPT和Claude,以补充他们的专业知识并尽可能全面地寻找相关证据。 专家对照物证记录检查了候选段落,判断其相关性,并记录了选定的块标识。 平均而言,每个问题都有两名专家作说明。 他们所选择的块标识符通过结合其说明并去除重复而合并.

blocks.en: Selection followed the question’s task. A lexical question calls for an explanation or equivalent of the term; a verse query calls for the requested text or its location; and a computational question calls for the relevant premises or rules. For false-premise questions, experts selected passages that contradicted the assumption or established the correct fact. A missing passage alone was insufficient grounds for a correction.
blocks.zh: 选择遵从问题的任务。 词汇问题要求解释或等同术语;诗句查询要求要求文本或其位置;计算问题要求相关前提或规则。 对于虚假的问题,专家们选择了与假设相矛盾或确定正确事实的段落. 仅缺失一段通道不足以作为更正的理由。

blocks.en: The 19 Composite (T06) and 15 Multi-hop (T07) questions received group annotations as well. Experts specified the intended answer scope, separated it into required facts or relations, and inspected which requirements each candidate supported. T06 groups had to cover every part of the query; T07 groups had to supply the facts and connections in the reasoning chain. Entity identities, aliases, chronology, and compatibility between passages were considered when combining chunks.
blocks.zh: 19个综合问题(T06)和15个多跳问题(T07)也收到了小组说明。 专家们具体说明了预定的答案范围,将其分为必要的事实或关系,并检查了每个候选人所支持的要求。 T06组必须涵盖查询的每个部分;T07组必须提供推理链中的事实和关联. 在合并块时,考虑了实体身份、别名、时间顺序和段落之间的相容性。

blocks.en: Alternative combinations were retained when they supplied the same required support. Redundant supersets were removed, and a singleton was accepted when one chunk covered the whole scope. Section 6 formalizes these groups and illustrates them with a released question. In the released annotations, the flat gold list for T06/T07 is the union of their groups; the other 10 categories use their reviewed passage lists.
blocks.zh: 提供同样所需支助的替代组合被保留。 多余的超集被移除,当一个块覆盖整个范围时,一个单子被接受. 第6节将这些群体正规化,并用一个释出的问题加以说明。 在所发布的说明中,T06/T07的平面金色列表是他们组的结合;其他10个类别则使用他们经过审查的通过列表.

blocks.en: 8.2. BM25 configuration and reproducibility
blocks.zh: 8.2. BM25的配置和可复制性

blocks.en: The BM25 baseline is implemented with Pyserini ( 7 ) , which provides a Python interface to the Lucene-based Anserini retrieval toolkit. Only the chunk field is indexed, and the original question string is submitted as the query. Identifiers name the indexed documents; category labels, relevance judgments, and bibliographic metadata are excluded from the searchable text.
blocks.zh: BM25基线与Pyserini (7 )一起被实施,后者为基于Lucene的Anserini检索工具包提供了Python接口. 只有块字段被索引,原始的问题字符串作为查询提交. 标识符列出索引文件的名称;可搜索文本中不包括类别标签、相关判断和书目元数据。

blocks.en: Parameters are fixed at k 1 = 0.9 k_{1}=0.9 and b = 0.4 b=0.4 , without tuning on the evaluation questions. The underlying Anserini English analyzer applies stopword removal and Porter stemming to the index and queries. Retrieval returns up to 1,000 matching chunks per question, retaining shorter lists when fewer match. All metrics use the same saved rankings and released relevance annotations.
blocks.zh: 参数被固定为k 1=0.9 k_{1}=0.9和b=0.4 b=0.4,没有调整评价问题. 基础的Anserini英语分析器应用了句法去除和由索引和查询产生的波特. 检索每个问题最多可返回1,000个匹配块,在匹配较少时保留较短的列表。 所有度量衡都使用相同的被保存的排名并发布了相关说明.

The repository linked in Section 3.3 documents dependencies and commands for retrieval and scoring.

blocks.en: 10. Discussion
blocks.zh: 10个 讨论情况

blocks.en: The results support different choices for passage lookup and evidence collection. For Question 1, “What is Jatharagni?”, BM25 places a gold passage first, giving reciprocal rank 1. Yet it retrieves only 1 of the 21 gold chunks within 20 results, a recall of 4.8%. A reader seeking one useful starting passage and a researcher assembling a broader set of references would experience this ranking differently. Reporting MRR alongside coverage makes that difference visible.
blocks.zh: 结果支持了对通道检查和证据收集的不同选择。 对于问题1,“Jatharagni是什么?” BM25将黄金通道放在第一位,给予对等等级。 1. 联合国 然而,它只回收了21个金块中的1个 在20个结果中,4.8%被召回。 一个读者想要一个有用的起始段落,而一个研究者收集一套更广泛的参考文献,将会经历不同的排名。 报告MRR和覆盖面使这种差异显而易见。

blocks.en: 10.1. Retrieval differences across question categories
blocks.zh: 10.1 (英语). 收回问题类别之间的差异

blocks.en: Verse retrieval is a priority for improvement on this collection. Of the 26 T08 questions, 25 have no gold hit within 20 results. Their median gold-set size is only 1.5 chunks (Table 5 ), so the poor coverage cannot be explained simply by sets that exceed the retrieval budget. Error inspection should examine how a question names or paraphrases its target, which scripts or transliterations occur in the indexed passage, and whether textual references are preserved. These checks can guide experiments with normalization, verse-specific indexing, or semantic matching. The scores identify the failure pattern; they do not determine which of these changes will resolve it.
blocks.zh: Verse reference是改进此集的优先. 在26个T08问题中,有25个在20个结果内没有被金子击中. 它们的中位金套尺寸只有1.5个块(表5),因此不能简单地用超过回收预算的套件来解释覆盖率低的问题. 出错检查应当检查一个问题名称或参数如何解释其目标,索引段落中发生哪些脚本或转写,以及是否保留了文字引用. 这些检查可以指导常态化的实验,特异性地索引化,或语义相匹配. 分数可以识别出失败模式;它们不能确定这些变化中哪一个能够解决.

blocks.en: The category rankings also resist a single ordering of task difficulty. Fact questions lead on first-hit rank, false-premise questions on Recall@20, and interpretive questions on Precision@3 (Figure 6 ). T12’s relatively high recall accompanies a median of 2 gold chunks, compared with 9 for T01. At the other extreme, the largest T10 set contains 2,549 chunks: even 20 gold hits would recover only 0.8% of it. Researchers should therefore compare methods within the categories relevant to their application and examine annotation size when interpreting recall. A category average combines the requested task, the selected sources, and the breadth of its gold judgments.
blocks.zh: 类别排名也抵制单次任务难度排序. 事实问题导致头一击的分级,在Recall@20上的假的分级问题,在Precision@3(图6)上的解释性问题. T12的召回率相对较高,中间值为2个金块,而T01为9个金块. 在另一个极端,最大的T10集包含2,549个块:甚至20个金命中只能恢复其中的0.8%. 因此,研究人员应比较与其应用有关的类别中的方法,并在解释召回时审查注释大小。 一个类别平均值结合了所请求的任务、选定的来源及其金质判断的广度。

blocks.en: 10.2. Choosing the retrieval budget
blocks.zh: 10.2 (英语). 选择检索预算

blocks.en: Increasing the cutoff offers a measurable but limited tradeoff. Doubling the result list from 10 to 20 raises macro Recall by 4.7 percentage points, while Precision falls from 0.115 to 0.083 (Table 7 ). The added passages may help evidence collection, but they also increase the material to inspect or pass to a model. F1 peaks at 8 results among the tested cutoffs; this balances the recorded judgments under that metric, without establishing the best budget for every application. An interface for browsing passages and a system assembling support for several subquestions can reasonably require different cutoffs. Chunk lengths also vary, so the text budget should be measured alongside the number of results.
blocks.zh: 增加截断提供了可衡量但有限的取舍。 将结果清单从10个翻倍到20个,使宏观召回增加了4.7个百分点,而精度则从0.115降至0.083(表7)。 增加的段落可能有助于收集证据,但也增加了用于检查或传递给模型的材料. F1在测试的截断点中达到8个结果的峰值;这平衡了该指标下记录的判决,但没有为每项申请确定最佳预算。 浏览段落的接口和集合几个子问题支持的系统可以合理地要求不同的截取. 春克长度也各有不同,因此文本预算应该与结果数量同时来测量.

blocks.en: 10.3. Recovering complete evidence groups
blocks.zh: 10.3 (英语). 追回完整的证据组

blocks.en: Group recovery provides a separate decision criterion for composite and multi-hop queries. At 20 results, 24 of the 34 questions still lack a complete annotated group (Table 9 ); expanding from 10 to 20 completes support for 3 additional questions. For these failures, the useful diagnostic is which required member is missing and where it appears in the saved ranking. Reranking can promote a member already in the candidate set; evidence absent from that set requires a change to candidate generation. CE_Recall and CE_MRR can then test whether the revised pipeline completes more groups and completes them earlier.
blocks.zh: 集体回收为综合查询和多跳查询提供了单独的决定标准。 根据20个结果,34个问题中有24个仍然缺乏完整的附加说明的分组(表9);另外3个问题从10个增加到20个。 对于这些失败,有用的诊断是,需要的成员缺失,并且出现在被保存的排名中。 重新排序可以提升已经列入候选人名单的成员;没有列入该名单的证据需要改变候选人的产生方式。 CE_回顾和CE_ 然后,MRR可以测试修改后的管道是否完成更多的组并提前完成.

blocks.en: 10.4. Error analysis and method comparison
blocks.zh: 10.4. 错误分析和方法比较

blocks.en: The corpus records support inspection of these errors at the passage and source levels. A failed match may involve the retrieved wording, an edition-specific reference, OCR text, or a machine-translated commentary. OCR and translation accuracy were not independently evaluated, so their contribution to the observed errors requires source checking. Subsequent comparisons with dense or hybrid retrieval should retain the same corpus, questions, labels, and cutoffs. This provides a basis for deciding whether gains come from better candidate coverage, improved ordering, or more successful assembly of the annotated groups.
blocks.zh: 人身检查记录有助于检查通过和来源各级的错误。 失败的匹配可能涉及检索到的措辞、特定版本的参考、OCR文本或机器翻译的评论。 OCR和翻译的准确性没有得到独立的评价,因此它们对所观察到的错误的贡献需要源头检查. 随后与稠密或混合检索的比较应保留相同的实体、问题、标签和断接点。 这为决定候选人覆盖面的扩大、订单的改进或附加说明的团体的更成功组合是否带来收益提供了依据。

blocks.en: 11. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 11个 结论

blocks.en: Dhārā Bench brings together an IKS corpus, 12 question categories, expert passage judgments, and source-linked records for shared retrieval evaluation. Its conjugate groups capture alternative combinations of passages supporting composite and multi-hop questions. The BM25 results expose two practical gaps: annotated passages are frequently absent from short result lists, especially for verse queries, and early access to one relevant chunk often leaves required support incomplete. Category-wise scores and group-completion measures make these gaps available for targeted comparison. The public corpus, rankings, and scoring scripts provide a common starting point for testing changes to candidate generation, ranking, and evidence assembly.
blocks.zh: Dhārā法官组汇集了IKS程序、12个问题类别、专家通过判决和与来源有关的记录,供共享检索评价。 它的集合组捕捉支持复合和多跳题的通道的替代组合. BM25结果暴露出两个实际差距:附加说明的段落往往没有出现在简短的结果清单中,特别是用于诗句查询,而早期获得一个相关块往往使需要的支持不完整。 按类别分数和分组完成措施使这些差距可供有针对性地比较。 公文,排名,和评分脚本为测试候选人生成,排名,和证据组装的变化提供了一个共同的起点.
